title: Barbara & Dougie Sitting in Backyard Lawn, 1940s Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription:
845 F
Barbara & Dougie in
the back yard.
description: A charming mid-20th-century black-and-white snapshot showing two young children, identified on the reverse as Barbara and Dougie, sitting cross-legged together on a grassy backyard lawn on a bright sunny day. Barbara wears a crewneck sweater, trousers, and ribbons in her curled hair, while Dougie wears shorts and a sweater vest over a collared shirt. In the background, a wooden picket fence, detached garages, residential houses, and another child playing in the distance reflect everyday American suburban life during the post-World War II era.
